prompts.landscape: Use case: ads-marketing. Adapt the supplied Degul Degul cover into a 1920x1080, wide 16:9 CrazyGames game cover. Reference image is the existing approved cover; preserve its soft chalky pastel paper illustration, lavender puzzle blocks, peach/mint/yellow rounded SQUARE friends with cute small faces, matching destination tiles and a purple portal. Compose specifically for this aspect ratio; do not stretch artwork. Replace all existing title lettering with ONLY the English game title "Degul Degul" in large chunky hand-drawn squishy purple and cream lettering. No other text, no Korean lettering, no store logos, no borders, no call-to-action. Consistent art and character identity with the reference, tactile matte 2D texture, gentle depth only, no glossy 3D sheen. Title and all three friends must be clearly readable in thumbnail size, comfortably inside edges. Deliver a single polished cover at 1920x1080, wide 16:9.
